integrity: Standalone exact dynamic programs and exhaustive finite microscopic checks corroborate the separately proved arbitrary-height recurrence; these computations alone are not an infinite proof. Independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns synchronous neighbor-majority on perfect rooted binary trees with root ties retained. It counts recurrent configurations and temporal orbits, not attraction basins or general-tree transient times. The fixed-point component is known from earlier literature; historical equivalence of the new all-period-two census cannot be fully excluded because relevant older full text was unavailable.
title: Complete period-two census and a one-fifth root-oscillation law for majority dynamics on perfect binary trees
